english: Let $PQ$ be a focal chord of the parabola $y^{2}=36x$. The region bounded by the parabola and the tangents to it at $P$ and $Q$ has area $500$. If the slope of $PQ$ is negative, then the slope of $PQ$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $PQ$ परवलय $y^{2}=36x$ की एक नाभि जीवा है। परवलय तथा $P$ और $Q$ पर इसकी स्पर्श रेखाओं से परिबद्ध क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल $500$ है। यदि $PQ$ की प्रवणता ऋणात्मक है, तो $PQ$ की प्रवणता ______ है।
solution: Tangents meet at $T(9t_{1}t_{2},9(t_{1}+t_{2}))$; area of $\triangle PTQ=\dfrac{a^{2}}{2}D^{3}$

Segment cut off by $PQ$ (Archimedes) $=\dfrac{2}{3}\cdot\triangle PTQ=\dfrac{a^{2}}{3}D^{3}$, so the region $=\dfrac{a^{2}}{6}D^{3}=\dfrac{81}{6}D^{3}=500\Rightarrow D^{3}=\dfrac{1000}{27}\Rightarrow D=\dfrac{10}{3}$
Slope of $PQ=\dfrac{2}{t_{1}+t_{2}}=\dfrac{2}{t_{1}-\frac{1}{t_{1}}}=\pm\dfrac{3}{4}$; the negative one is $-\dfrac{3}{4}$
solution_full: For $y^{2}=36x$, $a=9$. Let $P=(9t_{1}^{2},18t_{1})$, $Q=(9t_{2}^{2},18t_{2})$. The chord $PQ$ passes through the focus $(9,0)$ exactly when $t_{1}t_{2}=-1$.

The region between the chord $PQ$ and the arc is a parabolic segment; by Archimedes it is $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of the triangle formed by the chord and the tangents at its ends, i.e. $\dfrac{81}{3}|t_{1}-t_{2}|^{3}$.
The region bounded by the parabola and the two tangents is the triangle minus the segment: $\dfrac{81}{2}D^{3}-\dfrac{81}{3}D^{3}=\dfrac{81}{6}D^{3}$, where $D=|t_{1}-t_{2}|$.
So the slope is $\pm\dfrac{3}{4}$, and the negative value is $-\dfrac{3}{4}=-0.75$.
originality_note: New: the area between a parabola and the tangents at the ends of a focal chord is used in reverse to recover the chord's slope; Archimedes' 2/3 rule turns the curved region into (1/6)a^2 |t1 - t2|^3, and t1 t2 = -1 turns |t1 - t2| into |t + 1/t| (way 5). Closest known: area of the triangle formed by two tangents and their chord of contact, and the standard facts about focal-chord tangents (listed skeleton ingredients, used here only as steps). Different because: the unknown is the slope, the region is the curved one, and two parameter values give the same chord.

concept_use.Tangent to the parabola: point, slope an: The parametric tangents ty = x + 9t^2 at P and Q are intersected to get T(9t1t2, 9(t1 + t2)) for the triangle PTQ.
concept_use.Area bounded by a curve and its tangent,: The area of the region between the parabola and the two tangents is computed as triangle PTQ minus the parabolic segment on the chord PQ.
